entries.zh: 家计；家里财物（alhajas，orraices，debiene 为「家内财物、家产」类义：珠宝首饰/家产/财产之列）
entries.en: household property; family goods and means (jewels, estates, assets of the house)
entries.notes: 西语词头系多个条目压缩连写，义项组合依赖推断，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 家内个物（家里的东西、屋内财物）
entries.en: goods or valuables kept inside the house

entries.zh: 厝内个物（屋里的东西、家中器物）
entries.en: things inside the house; household goods

entries.zh: 义仓（官设济荒备赈的粮仓；aljondiga 即公仓/粮仓）
entries.en: state granary for famine relief; alhóndiga, public grain store

entries.zh: 气（气息、呼吸；aliento 或 resuello）

entries.en: labored or hurried breathing; shortness of breath

entries.zh: 撫（抚养、养育；alimentar 与 criar 并列）
entries.en: to nourish, rear, bring up (alimentar, criar)
entries.notes: 西语词头 A. limentar.y.sus tentar.criar. 系缩写连排，展开依赖推断，降中置信。

entries.en: to raise and support, to feed and bring up

entries.zh: 养（养育；兼收养为子 prohijar 之义）
entries.en: to nourish, rear; to take as one's own child (prohijar)

entries.zh: 养成（养育至成人，养大成年）
entries.en: to bring up until grown, to rear to manhood

entries.zh: 供火头（供饭食火头/供养饭头；西语残缺，似谓供养伙夫饭食，具体所指存疑）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to provide food for the cook/fire-head (sense uncertain; Spanish headword damaged)
entries.notes: 词头 alimentard[残]hijoael go. 残缺，火头（伙夫）义结合汉字与闽南音推断，语义无法完全定夺。

entries.zh: 丢落水（抛入水中；alijar en la tormenta 似谓风浪中抛掷）
entries.en: to throw into the water; to cast overboard (in the storm)

entries.zh: 拘却丢（被拘押后丢弃/先行拘弃再抛；西语同上系变体，语义不甚明）
entries.en: to seize and then discard, cast away (variant of the above; sense partly unclear)
entries.notes: 闽南栏首字 [残]，汉字「拘却丢」组合罕见，西语为上条变体，故降低置信。
